title: Homepage » Front & Back End Overview
text:
## Homepage » Front & Back End Overview
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000069761
By default, all sites come with a Homepage that can be accessed using the " example.com/ home " URL. In this article, we will show where to edit each section of the Homepage.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12125207260/original/G9NqWwzJvS9mAoaiu6cTN_MEqgAn9DeRlw.png?1683654510 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12125207534/original/oF1OnU6FNoK6qGl08n1-iWSuiMHJTii3wQ.png?1683654774 | alt: ]

## Logo
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12125207565/original/liEs4HzzK39E8XIk1fv7UwNOpZW0sa43sQ.png?1683654808 | alt: ]
There are two available logo settings:
1. Upload an image in General Settings » Brand Images: Brand Images Tab
2. Create a logo in Design Settings » Logo Design: Design Settings » Logo Designer

## Header Mini Nav
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12125207624/original/NH0nusTzD8l_oE8fHV9Gi-9t-DCNpGOUPg.png?1683654892 | alt: ]
1. To edit the Links (Phone Number, Contact Us, Login) go to Toolbox » Menu Manager » Header Mini Nav: How to Edit the Header Mini Nav
2. To edit the Search Module and button colors go to Design Settings » Header Design: Header Search Module

## Main Menu
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12125207645/original/NCSfvVcUXxFSOZrBA3LIhLxxO5RxRSLluA.png?1683654923 | alt: ]
The Main Menu is also edited inside the Toolbox » Menu Manager » Header Main Menu: Header Main Menu & Main Menu Design

## Homepage Image and Search
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12125207695/original/LPqRrydm6EeAxlURJYFGtDbTsL_fVn-otQ.png?1683654957 | alt: ]
The Image and Search display can be edited inside the Design Settings: Homepage Search Settings

## Homepage Content
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12125207778/original/93Il1daJq6DBY2ACcHtUbNqqzkiUvzCppg.png?1683655044 | alt: ]
This is done through the Streaming Widget functionality available on all sites: How To Add Content On Your Homepage (Coupons, Newest Members, Main Categories, etc)

## Footer Menu & Newsletter Signup
The Footer Menu is edited in Toolbox » Menu Manager » Footer Menu: How to Edit the Footer
The design settings article for the Footer and Newsletter can be found here: Footer & Newsletter Design
